categories.label: City Water Systems
categories.intro: Municipal water in the Twin Cities is treated and safe, but it typically carries hardness minerals plus chlorine or chloramine disinfectant. These systems soften and filter every tap in the house.

categories.label: Well Water Systems
categories.intro: Private wells in Minnesota commonly carry iron, manganese and hardness, and in some areas hydrogen sulfide. Final well configuration depends on a water test — we review that with you by phone.

categories.label: Drinking Water / Reverse Osmosis
categories.intro: Point-of-use reverse osmosis treats the water you drink and cook with at a dedicated kitchen faucet. Included free with any whole-home system, or installed on its own.

categories.label: Optional Add-Ons
categories.intro: Protection layers recommended for most well-water installs.

systems.what_it_does: Softens and filters every drop of water entering your home. One high-capacity media tank handles hardness, chlorine, chloramine, taste and odor, so every faucet, shower and appliance gets treated water.
leads: 48,000-grain softening capacity
28 GPM system flow, no pressure loss
MSP ceramic disc valve with 72-hour memory backup
NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty

aspects.headline: It runs itself.
aspects.body: The MSP ceramic disc valve on top of the tank washes and recharges the system on its own. You never have to touch it. Ceramic discs inside last for years where the plastic and Teflon pistons other companies use wear and leak, and a 72-hour memory backup means a power outage never erases your settings.

aspects.headline: Goodbye, chlorine.
aspects.body: The city adds chlorine to keep water safe in the pipes, but you don't want to drink or shower in it. The Jacobi catalytic carbon tank is made from real coconut shells and grabs chlorine, chloramine, organic chemicals and bad tastes as water passes through. Every faucet in the house gets cleaner, better-tasting water.

aspects.headline: Soft water, every tap.
aspects.body: Hard water is water full of dissolved rock, calcium and magnesium. That's what leaves spots on dishes, crusty white buildup on faucets and dry skin. Millions of 10% crosslinked resin beads trade those rock minerals out of your water before it reaches your pipes. Softer skin, cleaner dishes, appliances that last years longer.

aspects.headline: Every bead gets used.
aspects.body: Polishing gravel packed under the media spreads water evenly across the whole tank and keeps fine media out of the distributor. Even flow means full contact time, so you get every grain of the rated capacity instead of water racing through one path.

aspects.headline: Built to spec.
aspects.body: Everything is sized for a real household: high flow so showers, laundry and sprinklers can all run at once with no pressure loss. NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty, and a free reverse osmosis drinking-water system included.

systems.what_it_does: Gives the Jacobi catalytic carbon tank and the 10% crosslinked resin tank their own dedicated high-capacity vessels. Each media bed works at full strength, ideal for larger households and heavy water use.
leads: The only dual-tank system designed to self-clean the carbon tank
30 GPM valve flow for high-demand homes
Dedicated media beds last longer and filter deeper
NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty

aspects.headline: A whole tank for chlorine.
aspects.body: Tank one is a dedicated Jacobi catalytic carbon tank. With its own full media bed it treats chlorine, chloramine, organic chemicals, taste and odor at full strength, and the MSP ceramic disc valve backwashes it clean on schedule, something most dual-tank systems never do for the carbon side.

aspects.headline: A whole tank for softening.
aspects.body: Tank two holds high-capacity 10% crosslinked resin that trades calcium and magnesium out of your water. Because it doesn't share a vessel with carbon, the bed is deeper, the contact time longer, and the capacity higher for big households and heavy water use.

aspects.headline: One valve runs both tanks.
aspects.body: A single MSP ceramic disc valve controls both tanks and backwashes them automatically. Ceramic sealing discs don't score, swell or tear like the rubber seals in piston valves, so the system stays leak-free without service calls.

aspects.headline: Even flow in both tanks.
aspects.body: Polishing gravel in each tank supports the media bed, spreads flow across the full diameter and prevents channeling, so both the Jacobi catalytic carbon tank and the 10% crosslinked resin tank deliver their full rated capacity.

aspects.headline: Built for demand.
aspects.body: Sized for larger homes: 30 GPM valve flow, 28 GPM system flow, dedicated media beds that last longer and filter deeper. NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty, and a free reverse osmosis drinking-water system included.

systems.name: Whole Home Complete Salt-Free Filtration System
systems.image_alt: Whole Home Complete Salt-Free Filtration System: carbon filtration tank cutaway and salt-free conditioning tank
systems.for: Homeowners who want whole-home carbon filtration and scale protection with no salt bags, no brine discharge and no regeneration cycles.

stages.title: Jacobi catalytic carbon tank
stages.text: The Jacobi catalytic carbon tank removes chlorine, chloramine, chemicals and odors from all your water.

stages.title: Salt-free conditioning tank
stages.text: The salt-free conditioning tank transforms hardness minerals so they can no longer form scale. It does not remove hardness the way 10% crosslinked resin does.

stages.title: Polishing gravel
stages.text: Polishing gravel supports even water distribution through the media.

stages.title: Clack in/out head
stages.text: Zero electricity, zero drain line, zero salt. The simplest system to own.

systems.what_it_does: Whole-home carbon filtration plus salt-free scale conditioning. No salt bags, no brine discharge, no regeneration cycles. Keeps healthy minerals in your water while stopping them from sticking to pipes and appliances.
leads: No salt, no brine discharge
Keeps beneficial calcium and magnesium in your water
Protects water heaters, dishwashers and plumbing from scale
Lowest-maintenance system in our lineup

aspects.headline: Goodbye, chlorine.
aspects.body: The Jacobi catalytic carbon tank removes chlorine, chloramine, organic chemicals and odors from all your water, made from renewable coconut shells and finished with a catalytic surface that breaks chloramine down instead of just holding it.

aspects.headline: Scale, without the salt.
aspects.body: The conditioning tank transforms hardness minerals so they can no longer form scale on pipes, water heaters and fixtures, while leaving healthy calcium and magnesium in the water. No salt, no brine discharge, no regeneration. It is not a softener, so you won't get the slick soft-water feel.

aspects.headline: Nothing to set. Nothing to plug in.
aspects.body: A Clack in/out head with a 3/4-inch distributor directs water down through the media and back up the riser. No regeneration cycle, no timer, no power, and a full 1-inch to 1¼-inch bypass for service.

aspects.headline: Every grain gets used.
aspects.body: Polishing gravel supports the media bed and spreads flow evenly through the tank, so the full carbon volume is in contact with your water on every pass.

aspects.headline: The simplest system to own.
aspects.body: Zero electricity, zero drain line, zero salt. 28 GPM valve flow, NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty, and a free tankless reverse osmosis drinking-water system included.

systems.image_alt: MSP Pure Water dual tank well-water system: softening resin tank and Katalox Light media tank cutaways with brine tank
systems.for: Minnesota well homes dealing with iron staining, manganese and hard water, treated without chemicals.

stages.title: MSP AIO ceramic disc valve
stages.text: The MSP AIO ceramic disc valve creates a pressurized air pocket that naturally oxidizes iron and manganese. No chemicals added.

stages.title: Katalox Light media
stages.text: Katalox Light media traps the oxidized particles and boosts pH for better-tasting water.

stages.title: 10% crosslinked resin tank
stages.text: A dedicated 10% crosslinked resin tank removes calcium and magnesium hardness.

stages.title: Polishing gravel and automatic backwash
stages.text: Polishing gravel keeps flow even, and both tanks self-clean with automatic backwashing.

included: Reverse osmosis drinking-water system (tank or tankless)
systems.note: Final well-water configuration may depend on water test results. We review testing as part of your phone consultation.
systems.what_it_does: Treats the two biggest well-water problems, iron and hardness, chemical-free, and handles manganese along the way. Air-oxidation technology plus Katalox Light media stop staining while a dedicated 10% crosslinked resin tank softens your water.
leads: Chemical-free iron and manganese treatment
Self-cleaning Katalox Light media, low maintenance
30 GPM valve flow built for well pumps
NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty

aspects.headline: Air does the work.
aspects.body: Well water often carries dissolved iron and manganese you can't see, until it stains your sinks orange. The MSP AIO ceramic disc valve keeps a pocket of pressurized air inside the tank. When water passes through, the air naturally turns those dissolved metals into solid particles the media can catch. No chemicals added, ever.

aspects.headline: Iron, trapped.
aspects.body: Once the air pocket turns iron and manganese into solid bits, the Katalox Light media bed traps them like a net, down to about 3 microns, and even nudges your water's pH up for better taste. It cleans itself with automatic backwashing, so maintenance stays close to zero.

aspects.headline: Soft water, every tap.
aspects.body: Well water is usually hard water too. The second tank is packed with 10% crosslinked resin beads that pull out the calcium and magnesium, so on top of clear, stain-free water you get soft water at every faucet and shower.

aspects.headline: Even flow in both tanks.
aspects.body: Polishing gravel under the Katalox Light and under the 10% crosslinked resin keeps flow even, prevents channeling and holds fine media out of the distributor, so both tanks deliver their full rated capacity.

aspects.headline: Built for well pumps.
aspects.body: 30 GPM valve flow built to keep up with well pumps, NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty, and a free reverse osmosis drinking-water system included. Add the pre-sediment filter and UV purifier for complete well protection.

systems.for: The system for rotten-egg sulfur odor, and for wells with heavier iron loads where air oxidation alone is not enough.

stages.text: The injection panel doses hydrogen peroxide the moment water enters your home, instantly breaking down iron and sulfur.

stages.title: Jacobi catalytic carbon tank

stages.title: 10% crosslinked resin tank
stages.text: A dedicated 10% crosslinked resin tank removes hardness for fully softened water.

stages.title: MSP ceramic disc valve and polishing gravel

systems.note: Final well-water configuration may depend on water test results. We review testing as part of your phone consultation.
systems.what_it_does: Our most powerful well-water solution, and the one we install for rotten-egg sulfur odor. Hydrogen peroxide oxidation destroys even severe iron and sulfur problems at the point of entry, then a dedicated Jacobi catalytic carbon tank and a 10% crosslinked resin tank finish the job.
leads: Handles the most severe iron and rotten-egg sulfur conditions
Stronger than air oxidation, works where other systems fail
Consistent chemical feed with dedicated holding tank
Complete package: oxidation + filtration + softening

aspects.headline: Sulfur, destroyed at the door.
aspects.body: The injection panel doses hydrogen peroxide the moment water enters your home. Peroxide is a far stronger oxidizer than air: it turns hydrogen sulfide gas into filterable sulfur and dissolved iron into solid particles within seconds, and it kills the sulfur bacteria that keep making the smell.

aspects.headline: Caught, and cleaned up.
aspects.body: A dedicated Jacobi catalytic carbon tank captures the oxidized iron and sulfur particles. The peroxide itself is consumed on the catalytic carbon and filtered out, so nothing but treated water reaches your faucets.

aspects.headline: Soft water, every tap.
aspects.body: A dedicated tank of 10% crosslinked resin removes calcium and magnesium hardness for fully softened water, on top of odor-free, stain-free water from the oxidation stages ahead of it.

aspects.kicker: MSP Ceramic Disc Valve & Polishing Gravel
aspects.headline: Self-cleaning, top to bottom.
aspects.body: The MSP ceramic disc valve backwashes captured contaminants down the drain automatically, and polishing gravel under each media bed keeps flow even and prevents channeling. Ceramic discs mean no rubber seals to wear out.

aspects.headline: Maximum strength.
aspects.body: Our most powerful well-water solution: oxidation, filtration and softening in one complete package, 28 GPM system flow, NSF-certified media, lifetime warranty, and a free reverse osmosis drinking-water system included.

systems.what_it_does: Purified, alkaline drinking water on demand, straight from a dedicated faucet at your sink. No storage tank, 70% less under-sink space, and water treated the moment you ask for it.
leads: 800 GPD capacity
2:1 low drain ratio, less water to drain
Alkaline remineralization for taste

aspects.headline: Down to 0.0001 microns.
aspects.body: A human hair is about 70 microns wide. This system filters down to 0.0001 microns through a spiral-flow RO membrane, reducing dissolved solids, chlorine, organic chemicals and everyday contaminants. Seven stages of protection between the pipe and your glass.

aspects.headline: The good minerals, back in.
aspects.body: Most RO systems strip everything out, including the minerals that make water taste great. The HW800 AlkaPro adds healthy minerals back in and balances the pH, so your water tastes crisp.

aspects.headline: 800 gallons a day, no tank.
aspects.body: Maximum output and 70% less under-sink space. Water is treated the moment you ask for it, with a 2:1 drain ratio that sends far less water down the drain than a traditional tank system.

aspects.headline: Twist. Swap. Done.
aspects.body: Filters twist out and twist in. No tools, no technician, no appointment. The auto-flush system even cleans the RO membrane by itself to make every filter last longer.
